passages.title: A noisy night
passages.text: Guest: Excuse me, I'd like to make a complaint. There seems to be a problem with the air conditioning in my room. It's been making a loud noise all night. Manager: I'm so sorry about that. I'm afraid all our other rooms are full tonight, but I can send someone to fix it right away. Guest: I'd appreciate it if you could do that before ten. I have an early meeting tomorrow. Manager: Of course. And we won't charge you for tonight. Guest: Thank you, that's very kind. Manager: Not at all. Again, I apologize for the trouble.
